mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_cart(group_id, ref_data_id, aup_record_id, spec_selections, quantity, remark, package_status, package_remark, added_by) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{refDataId}, #{aupRecordId}, #{specSelections}, #{quantity}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{packageStatus}, 'DRAFT'), #{packageRemark}, #{addedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ref_cart SET spec_selections = #{specSelections}, quantity = #{quantity}, remark = #{remark}, package_status = COALESCE(#{packageStatus}, package_status), package_remark = #{packageRemark}, aup_record_id = COALESCE(#{aupRecordId}, aup_record_id) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ref_cart WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ref_cart WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id ASC
